summary: Assign the reflexive self-occupation example to sense 2
rationale: Both komaǧġalno ruḥi and komaǧə́ġli ruḥayye explicitly take reflexive ruḥ- objects. The entry defines sense 2 as (ruḥo) sich beschäftigen, while sense 1 is occupying/distracting someone else. The parallel maǧġele ruḥe hiye is already assigned to sense 2.
